declaration.task: Describe price paths of all six-month existing classic ORB trades; no order calls, MT5 access, strategy changes or parameter optimization
declaration.primary: RVOL>=1 at COST_STRESS_1.5x; all-volume control and observed1x shown separately
declaration.cohorts: All first daily closed opportunities; filtered subset rvol>=1; never exclude losing months or symbols
declaration.path: Executable liquidation netR at observed bid/ask widened by fixed factor, adverse0.1pip/side*factor, original fixed roundtripcommission; include entry-quote immediate liquidation; TP terminal capped at recorded fill; only up to actual terminal exit for MFE/MAE
declaration.later_path: After actualSL continue observing to first16:00Londonquote only as hindsight diagnostic; never count later target as recoverable profit or ignore intervening stop risk
declaration.return_inside: Strict return within broken BID boundary after entry and before exit; any simple retest must avoid conditioning on future win/loss
declaration.categories: TP2, SL without+0.5netR, SL after+0.5netR, EOD positive/negative; categories descriptive not causal or alternativeexit returns
declaration.parity: Reconstruct chronological entry/exit indices, direction/risk/fills/fees and compare all original CLOSED fields; fail on any discrepancy; preserve same-millisecond order; inputs rehash before/after
declaration.next_step: Do not auto-add BE/TP1 or assume retest profitable from MFE. If only a minority of losers first earn+0.5R, deprioritize profit-management rescue. Retest can be justified for separate experiment only when loser reversal/return differs descriptively from winners; previous negativeM1tests remain relevant. Any future strategy needs frozen causal rules and separate validation.
declaration.limitations: Already-seen historical periods; no OOS, no fitted threshold, no causal claim, no account equity, no independent fill guarantee
